subject.title: refactor(heartbeat): remove legacy HEARTBEAT.md runtime fallback and template repair

question: Should this fallback-removal cleanup land immediately, as the updated PR body states, or wait until a stable release containing the database-scratch migration has completed an upgrade window, as the branch commit message states?
rationale: Both paths intentionally change upgrade behavior for users with legacy workspace files, and the branch’s own durable records conflict on timing.

options.title: Land now with Doctor as the sole bridge
options.body: Confirm the July 24, 2026 operator decision, retain the Doctor migration, and require a real pre-migration-to-scratch proof artifact before merge.

options.title: Wait through a stable upgrade window
options.body: Keep the fallback until a stable release carrying the migration has shipped and the intended upgrade period has elapsed.
